description: List training venues with address, grouped by state. Pass state to narrow to one state, or near (an Australian postcode or suburb the person gives you, such as "4510" or "Caboolture QLD") to get the closest venues with their distance in km. The id of a venue is the location for search_sessions.

limit.description: With near, how many venues to return. Values below 1 use the default.

near.description: A postcode or suburb, optionally with its state, such as 4510 or Caboolture QLD.

state.description: A state or territory, such as QLD, in any case. Ignored when near is given.

name: list_locations

locations.description: The venues; null when there are none.

distance_km.description: The distance from near in kilometres, to one decimal place. Present only on distance-ordered results.

id.description: The venue's id. The session endpoints accept it as location.

state.description: The state or territory, such as QLD.

near.description: With near, the place it resolved to, or null when the lookup didn't say.

title: List training venues
